style_alignment.rationale: Warm plum-brown rock ramp sampled from tunnel-interior; chunky 16x16 strata cells read as the same tunnel wall material at 3x against the dim floor band, not a foreign patch.

identity_continuity.rationale: Supersedes #420 cyan-ore seam face with generic rock; four damage keys and vertical-repeat footprint preserved for mining-tunnel wiring.

questions.question: No tile contains ore, crystal, metal, or a coloured vein — the rock is unambiguously plain.
questions.notes: All four tiles use plum-brown ramp only; zero cyan-class pixels in runtime PNGs or provider raw.

questions.question: The four states are ordered unambiguously by damage at native scale, with hue removed.
questions.notes: intact solid strata → chipped pale scars → cracked central fracture void → crumbling large cavity; progression reads left-to-right in composite.

questions.question: Each tile repeats vertically down the full 112px column with no visible seam.
questions.notes: Row 0 equals row 15 on all four tiles; 3x vertical repeat in 48x112 columns shows no horizontal discontinuity.

questions.question: The rock reads as the same material as the tunnel background it sits against, not as a foreign patch.
questions.notes: Shared plum-brown values (#1f1014–#69452c) against tunnel-interior crop; strata banding matches wall cobble vocabulary.

questions.question: Every tile is exactly 16x16 with no magenta and no anti-aliased edge pixels.
questions.notes: All four PNGs 16x16 RGBA binary alpha; zero magenta and zero semi-transparent pixels.
